subject: Request: SAML/SCIM/RBAC evidence and least-privilege justification for ClearMind
messages:
From: Amanda Lewis <amanda.lewis@clearmindhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@clearmindhealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SAML/SCIM/RBAC evidence and least-privilege justification for ClearMind

Kimberly —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake we need concrete artifacts tied to the ClearMind production tenant to satisfy a few control checks. Can you provide the following? Ideally we need delivery within 4 business days:

- SAML assertion samples emitted by Redwood's IdP integration (one successful login, one expired token example). Include the assertion XML, stated Audience, NameID format, and the main attributes you surface to downstream services.
- SCIM delta logs for the ClearMind tenant covering the prior 30 days (changes only; create/update/delete with timestamps and actor). Prefer NDJSON or CSV.
- RBAC snapshot: role -> permission mapping for roles used by ClearMind, and a short rationale (1–2 sentences) for why each role exists (least-privilege justification).
- Service account inventory for any non-human principals that access customer data or admin APIs (name, owner, privileges, last-used timestamp).
- Any notes on safeguards we should expect (e.g., time-limited tokens, approval gates, change control references).

If any of the items contain customer-identifiable info that you can’t share verbatim, we can accept redacted examples and a short explanation of what was redacted. Please also include a secure transfer option (SFTP link or Drive share) and the contact for any follow-ups.

Appreciate it — this is time-boxed on our side.

Amanda Lewis
Security Operations
ClearMind Health
compliance@clearmindhealth.com

--
On Sat, Jul 14, 2028 at 08:55 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the recap — happy to help.
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Lewis <amanda.lewis@clearmindhealth.com>
Cc: compliance@clearmindhealth.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML/SCIM/RBAC evidence and least-privilege justification for ClearMind

Amanda —

Thanks for the clear list. We can produce the items you requested. Plan/owners below:

- SAML assertion samples (kimberly_park) — will include one successful assertion and one expired assertion, with a brief field map.
- SCIM delta logs (marcus_lin) — export NDJSON of change events for the tenant for the 30-day window. We will scrub any full SSNs/PII and note redactions.
- RBAC snapshot + rationale (jordan_blake) — role/permission CSV and short bullets explaining least-privilege decisions.
- Service account inventory (kimberly_park) — CSV with owner and last-used.

Questions before we proceed:
1) For the SCIM deltas, do you require prior-history (full audit) or only the change events?
2) Preferred transfer method: we can put the package on a secured Drive link (with link expiry and restricted viewers) or provide an SFTP drop. Which do you prefer?

I’ll coordinate internal packaging and expect to deliver a first bundle by Tue EOD (3 business days). Marcus / Jordan — can you confirm you can meet that timeline?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Amanda / ClearMind compliance team —

Attached is the compiled evidence package per your request. Summary of payload: 

- saml_assertion_samples.xml — two assertions: 1) successful_login.xml (Audience: https://api.redwood.com; NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress; attributes: email, given_name, family_name, roles), 2) expired_token.xml (shows NotOnOrAfter)
- scim_delta_2028-06-14_to_2028-07-14.ndjson — change events with pseudo-ids, README explains redaction mapping and schema
- rbac_role_mapping_matrix.csv — role -> permission matrix for ClearMind tenant; each role has a 1–2 sentence justification column documenting least-privilege rationale
- service_account_inventory.csv — non-human principals, owner, privileges, and last-used ISO timestamps
- rbac_review_playbook.pdf — short runbook describing how we recommend customers validate roles and request temporary elevates via RBAC change workflow

Transfer method: secure Drive share (link below) with viewer expiration set to 7 days. If you prefer SFTP, we can re-export and provide credentials.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/ClearMind/IAM-evidence-pack
JIRA: RWD-1459

If these artifacts meet your needs we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough to step through the assertions and role matrix next week.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
